econometric_drivers.title: Cushing WTI Econometric Drivers
econometric_drivers.description: Located 50 miles west of Tulsa, Cushing, OK is the physical delivery point for NYMEX WTI crude. Localized rack margins reflect direct crude benchmark access, regional crack spreads, and Mid-Continent market competition.

refining_logistics.title: West Tulsa Refining & Supply Logistics
refining_logistics.description: HF Sinclair West Tulsa Refinery (125,000 bpd capacity) processes sweet/sour crude streams, dispatching refined unleaded blendstock across Magellan Pipeline terminals to local jobbers and retail stations.

tax_structure.title: Oklahoma Tax Structure & Statutory Overhead
tax_structure.description: Oklahoma state motor fuel tax ($0.190/gal) plus US Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal) and UST fees create a total statutory tax burden of $0.374/gal—the lowest tax overhead among Midgley metro benchmarks.
tax_structure.notes: Lowest statutory tax overhead among Midgley metro benchmarks

infrastructure_delivery.title: Tulsa Delivery Hub & Dynamic Rack Margin
infrastructure_delivery.description: Calibrates wholesale futures returns directly into Creek, Tulsa & Rogers county tank truck dispatch prices.
